Tips don't add up to a business.

You can watch fifty videos about starting a store and still not know what to do on Monday morning. Every one of them starts over, assumes something different, and stops before the hard part. The Guide is the opposite: one path, start to finish, where each lesson assumes the one before it.

1Pick a product worth sellingDemand, competition, and what a sale really earns you
2Build a store that sellsPages that answer the questions buyers actually have
3Earn trust and smooth the checkoutThe small doubts that stop people paying
4Market with email first, then adsJudge every channel by profit, not clicks
5Ship orders and keep customersDeliver the same way every time as orders grow

What you actually get

Real screens from the app, not mock-ups.

A course, not a pile of links

Every chapter opens as numbered modules with a plain goal at the top. You always know where you are and what comes next, and the next lesson opens when you finish the one before it.

Lessons that end in something to do

Plain writing, worked examples with real numbers, and one concrete next step at the bottom of every lesson. You finish reading and you know exactly what to go and do.

Narrated video lessons

Watch it or read it, whichever suits the moment. The key points come up on screen as they're spoken, so it works with the sound off on a bus.

An AI mentor that knows your chapter

Stuck on pricing, a client email, or what to do next? Ask The Guider inside the chapter you're working through and get a straight answer about your situation.

The tools to actually run it

Invoices, expenses, clients, recurring revenue and tax set-aside, built into the same app, so the business you're learning to start has somewhere to live.

    Questions people ask

    Do I need any experience?

    No. Every course starts from nothing and assumes you haven't done this before. If a term needs explaining, the lesson explains it.

    How much time does it take?

    Lessons are short enough to do in a sitting. A module opens each week, so most people spend a few evenings a week on it rather than a whole weekend.

    What if I pick the wrong chapter?

    Switch whenever you like. Pro opens all sixteen courses, and whatever you've finished stays finished.

    Can I cancel?

    Yes, in one tap from your account page. You keep Pro until the period you've paid for ends, and anything you've already finished stays open to you.

    What if Pro isn't for me?

    Email us within 7 days of your first payment and we'll refund it in full. No forms, no questions you have to answer.

    Is this a get-rich-quick thing?

    No. It teaches how these businesses actually work: pricing, clients, contracts, delivery, money. Nobody can promise what you'll earn, and we don't.

    Pick one. Start today.

    The first module is free, and you'll have done something real by the end of it.

    Before you dive in…

    What this is. The Guide pairs practical, no-fluff guides with real business tools (client trackers, schedulers, goal tracking) built specifically for whatever kind of work you actually do.

    Why we built it. Good guidance and good tools shouldn't only be available to people who can afford an expensive course or an agency. This is meant to be the thing you actually open daily, not a course you buy and forget.

    What's next. A couple of quick questions so we can set up your home screen around what you're actually working on. Takes about 20 seconds, or skip it entirely, your call.

    The Guide
